The heart of French football will pulsate with anticipation as Paris Saint-Germain faces off against Paris FC in a highly anticipated Coupe de France encounter. This Parisian derby, while perhaps not traditionally as fierce as some, carries immense weight for both sides: PSG aims to assert its dominance and advance effortlessly, while Paris FC dreams of a giant-killing act to etch their name in cup history. With both teams eager to prove their mettle, this fixture promises an intriguing blend of tactical prowess and raw passion under the floodlights. Kick-off: 12.01.2026, 20:10 UTC / 23:10 MSK
Stadium: Parc des Princes
Competition: France - Coupe de France

Match Preview

This Coupe de France clash pits two Parisian clubs against each other, though their standings in the French football hierarchy couldn't be more different. Paris Saint-Germain, the perennial Ligue 1 champions and a force in European football, will be looking to maintain their domestic cup dominance. Manager Luis Enrique is expected to field a strong side, albeit with potential rotations given the packed fixture schedule. For PSG, the Coupe de France represents another opportunity for silverware and a chance to deepen their squad's competitive rhythm. On the other side, Paris FC, currently plying their trade in Ligue 2, will approach this fixture as a monumental challenge and a chance to make a statement. Their season has been a battle for consistency, and a victory over their illustrious neighbors would undoubtedly be the highlight. Manager Stéphane Gilli will need his team to be impeccably organized, disciplined, and seize every slight opportunity if they are to cause an upset. Historically, such derby encounters in cup competitions often bring out an extra level of fight and determination, irrespective of league standings.

Team Form and Analysis

PSG

Paris Saint-Germain enters this match in formidable form, consistently delivering dominant performances in Ligue 1 and progressing smoothly in Europe. Their attack, featuring a constellation of global superstars, remains potent, capable of dismantling any defense. Defensively, under Luis Enrique, they have shown periods of vulnerability but generally maintain strong control of games. Injury-wise, PSG's squad depth allows them to manage any minor knocks without significantly impacting their overall strength. Key players like Kylian Mbappé and Ousmane Dembélé are likely to feature, at least for a portion of the game, to ensure PSG's progression.

Paris FC

Paris FC's recent form has been mixed, reflecting their mid-table position in Ligue 2. They possess a solid, hardworking squad, but lack the individual brilliance of their opponents. Their strength lies in their collective effort, defensive compactness, and ability to hit teams on the counter-attack, especially against more expansive sides. Manager Stéphane Gilli will likely opt for a cautious, disciplined approach, aiming to frustrate PSG and exploit any rare defensive lapses. Key players like Ilan Kebbal in midfield and Pierre-Yves Hamel up front will be crucial for their chances, providing creativity and a target man, respectively. Injury concerns for Paris FC could be more impactful given their shallower squad, making every fit player vital for this monumental task.
